catalog.name: get_house_view
catalog.description: Read vault house-view markdown for a desk.

catalog.name: get_pack_snapshot
catalog.description: Compiled pack + SoR-aware risk statuses (WATCH/FIRED). Use for daily/risk-check/steelman. Tripwires from pack (compile for full sync).

catalog.name: get_house_assist_context
catalog.description: Full assist pack: rules + pack + vault house. Use before drafting house edits.

catalog.name: propose_house_view
catalog.description: Propose CONFIRMED house after user GO (does NOT write vault house). Never FORMING. After propose, call commit_on_go. SAVE DRAFT / EDIT must not call this.

markdown.description: Full house-view markdown. Avoid if large — use markdown_path or propose_house_from_current.

markdown_path.description: Absolute path under /tmp or vault cockpit/proposals/

intent.description: go | save_draft — must match markdown status

catalog.name: propose_house_from_current
catalog.description: EFFICIENT propose: load current vault house, apply exact find→replace (each find must match once), store pending proposal. Prefer this over full-file propose. After user GO, commit_on_go. Does NOT write until then (or glass ACCEPT).

find.description: Exact substring in current house (must appear exactly once)

catalog.name: commit_on_go
catalog.description: Write vault after the user said GO. Same path as glass ACCEPT. kind=house needs pending CONFIRMED proposal_id. kind=register requires live house CONFIRMED. Do NOT call after SAVE DRAFT or EDIT. Not agent_accept.

utterance.description: User line verbatim (GO / looks good / CONFIRM / ACCEPT REGISTER)

catalog.name: list_house_proposals
catalog.description: List pending/accepted/rejected house proposals for a desk (no full markdown unless pending summary).

catalog.name: propose_risk_status
catalog.description: Propose INTACT|WATCH|FIRED for an existing risk. Does NOT write SoR until GO / commit_on_go (glass ACCEPT alternate).

risk_name.description: e.g. R3 — Customer concentration… or R3

catalog.name: propose_add_risk
catalog.description: Propose NEW risk on register (add_risk). Research first via pack/search; does NOT write SoR until GO / glass ACCEPT on Risks page.

catalog.name: propose_add_metric
catalog.description: Not wired. Use propose_add_risk (risk register). No Metrics page yet.

catalog.name: list_risk_proposals
catalog.description: List pending/accepted/rejected risk proposals (status_change + add_risk + set_tripwires).

catalog.name: get_risk_sor
catalog.description: Read one risk section from vault SoR (status + tripwires). Use before editing tripwires.

catalog.name: get_metric_sor
catalog.description: Not wired. Use get_risk_sor (register) or get_driver_sor (drivers).

catalog.name: list_house_driver_candidates
catalog.description: Does not dump house headings. You name 2–5 business engines with house_cite. User KEEP. Never auto-keep.

catalog.name: propose_keep_driver
catalog.description: KEEP a named engine (pending). Requires house_cite from the CONFIRMED house. GO writes 09. Does not write 08 or the house. No status.

house_cite.description: Quote from the live CONFIRMED house. The engine must already be in that house.

title.description: Engine name. Not a house heading.

watching.description: What the user wants watched on this engine

why.description: One paragraph: why this side of the business is the bull case

catalog.name: propose_driver_log
catalog.description: Append one log line and/or one still-open question to a kept driver (pending). GO writes 09 only. Does not write the house or 08.

figures.description: Replace the figures strip when a print updates the numbers

catalog.name: propose_skip_driver
catalog.description: SKIP a house quote (not a driver). Requires house_cite. Does not write 09/08.

catalog.name: get_driver_sor
catalog.description: Read 09 drivers (kept lines). Empty [] if no 09.

catalog.name: list_driver_proposals
catalog.description: List pending/accepted driver KEEP/SKIP proposals.

catalog.name: propose_risk_tripwires
catalog.description: Propose tripwire table for an existing risk (replace). Research with user first; SoR writes on GO / commit_on_go.

tripwires.description: Final list after user cull — only monitors Anthony wants

catalog.name: agent_accept_status
catalog.description: Whether this monorepo grants agent ACCEPT of house/risk proposals (scenario or COCKPIT_AGENT_ACCEPT=1).

catalog.name: accept_house_proposal
catalog.description: AGENT ACCEPT pending house proposal (writes vault house). Requires agent_accept grant (scenario default on). Same path as glass ACCEPT.

proposal_id.description: Pending house proposal id from list_house_proposals

catalog.name: accept_risk_proposal
catalog.description: AGENT ACCEPT pending risk proposal (writes risks SoR). Requires agent_accept grant. Same path as glass ACCEPT.

proposal_id.description: Pending risk proposal id from list_risk_proposals
